narrative.overview: Ensō Time should feel like a precise instrument left open beside the work: observant, legible, and calm enough to disappear until a decision is needed. The composition is flat and editorial, with measured dividers and a single blue signal instead of decorative effects. Ink and rice-paper themes are equal expressions of the same system.
keyCharacteristics: Quietly technical, with generous page margins and compact controls.
Evidence-first hierarchy built from timelines, rules, and thin dividers.
Restrained color where every accent has semantic meaning.
Rounded enough to be usable, never soft or toy-like.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue should occupy less than roughly ten percent of a screen; its rarity communicates action and live state.

rules.name: The Semantic Accent Rule
rules.body: Cyan, yellow, orange, and sage identify categories or state. They do not decorate containers.

rules.name: The Statement, Then Evidence Rule
rules.body: A Jost statement names the conclusion; compact Inter content immediately shows the evidence behind it.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Permanent content uses borders and tonal surfaces. A shadow must represent temporary elevation or interaction.

dos: Do use #1F8BFF for one primary action or live signal at a time.
Do preserve one-pixel dividers, 6–9px radii, and compact 40–43px controls.
Do pair every recommendation with visible local evidence.
Do keep both Ink and Rice Paper themes WCAG 2.2 AA and preserve meaning without color.
donts: Don't build generic AI productivity dashboards filled with gradients, glowing cards, and inflated scores.
Don't imitate surveillance software that hides what it records or makes users feel watched.
Don't use gamified habit trackers with streak anxiety, guilt, trophies, or celebratory noise.
Don't turn screens into dense enterprise analytics that require configuration before they become useful.
Don't reproduce ActivityWatch's full technical dashboard as the primary user experience.
Don't use colored side stripes, glassmorphism, gradient text, giant pill controls, or grids of identical rounded cards.
